int ReadFITSFile (  img_t *  img,
char *  infile,
char *  reply
) 
 

load a FITS image into memory

Parameters:
img pointer to a img_params data structure
fitsfile full name of the FITS format file to read
reply string to contain any messages from the process
Returns:
0 on success, -1 if errors
Opens the named FITS format image file readonly and attempts to read it into the data array in the img struct. Also loads the image dimensions, filename, object name (if an OBJECT card is present in the header), and sets the img_params::haveImage flag true.

Calls the HEASARC cfitsio library routines to do the dirty work.

int ImageMean (  img_t *  img,
int  step
) 
 

Compute the mean of the image.

Parameters:
img pointer to an img_params data structure
step interval to step through the image (1=all pixels)
Returns:
0 on success, -1 on errors
Computes the mean in the image. For speed, an optional "step" can be specified to step through the image every step-th pixel. For example, for computing a default display level, one might call ImageMean to compute the mean for every 9th pixel.
